name: HYPR L1StandardBridge reinitialization
summary: The HYPR L1StandardBridge implementation cleared the storage used by Initializable, leaving the deployed bridge reinitializable. The incident transaction reinitialized the bridge and released 2.57 million escrowed HYPR.
notes: The ProxyAdmin transaction installed 0xe468b43b4ae4d750cd6a5d7edacc1a751302c99c in the bridge proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot and initialized it. The receipt emitted Initialized(2), so selection is represented by the storage transition rather than an implementation-address event.

The transaction and commit-pinned reproduction record exactly 2,570,000 HYPR transferred from bridge custody. Rekt reported the amount as approximately $220,000; no independently reproducible incident-time HYPR price series was retained.
The $220,000 value is a contemporaneous reported approximation.
